title: WW3-SWRT: WAVEWATCH III 7.14 with the sparse Webb-Resio-Tracy (SWRT) nonlinear source term
description:
WAVEWATCH III (version 7.14) with the sparse Webb–Resio–Tracy (SWRT) source term for the nonlinear four-wave interaction, selected by the switch NL6. SWRT keeps K mirror-image pairs of configurations of the WRT integration space, each with an optimized gain; the operator here has K = 30.

The archive contains the model source (SWRT in model/src/w3snl6md.F90), the switch file, the K = 30 operator, and the namelists and scripts of a 1° global test. The large restart and ERA5 wind inputs of the test are not included.
